site.name: Black Diamond Mine
site.location: Lafayette / Baseline Road and U.S. 287 area
overview: Black Diamond Mine was a documented coal mine in the Lafayette area of Boulder County and part of the Boulder-Weld coal field.
Local historical records preserve the mine in Lafayette's twentieth-century coal-mining story, while USGS-derived mapping provides a stable mine-level location for identification.

timeline.text: A Lafayette historical photograph documents the interior of the Black Diamond Mine during its operating era.
Local and county historical sources identify Black Diamond as Lafayette's last coal mine to close.

moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places the named Black Diamond Mine near 39.948597, -105.233878 and records it as an inactive coal mine; the mapped point is used as a mine-level identification location rather than a claim that a surviving shaft or opening has been field-surveyed.
A surviving 1942 photograph is retained as historical evidence, but its item-level reuse terms are not sufficiently clear for app use, so no image is included with this record.
